setShapeTextOp.descriptionEn: Change the text inside a shape.
setShapeTextOp.limits: 找不到该形状报 IdNotFound。对 slide:{n} 或 slide:{n}/notes（没有 /shape:）发本 op 报 InvalidId。 对备注页、备注母版或讲义上占位符 p:ph/@type 为 sldImg 的形状发本 op 报 InvalidField，不写文件。 xlsx 改工作表文本框或无 txBox 形状的 xdr:txBody，规则与 pptx 相同（把下文的 p:sp / p:txBody 换成 xdr:sp / xdr:txBody）。
setShapeTextOp.limitsEn: A missing shape returns IdNotFound. This op on slide:{n} or slide:{n}/notes (no /shape:) returns InvalidId. This op on a shape on a notes page, notes master, or handout whose placeholder p:ph/@type is sldImg returns InvalidField and writes nothing. xlsx changes xdr:txBody of a worksheet text box or a shape without txBox, with the same rules as pptx (read p:sp / p:txBody below as xdr:sp / xdr:txBody).
